Name: ASTOR Program Radar Data Extension
Description: The ASTOR radar uses the NITF 2.1 standard to format its output data. The workstation server on the ASTOR aircraft may convert the data to STANAG 4545 for further dissemination. Both NITF 2.1 and STANAG 4545 use STDI-0002, The Compendium of Controlled Extensions, to define their Support Data Extensions. Shown below is a new tag, ASTORA, which the ASTOR program has created as a Registered Extension.

IMG_TOTAL_ROWS.Name: Number of rows in full image product
IMG_TOTAL_ROWS.Description: This field contains the number of rows in the image product.

IMG_TOTAL_COLS.Name: Number of columns in full image product
IMG_TOTAL_COLS.Description: This field contains the number of rows in the image product.

IMG_INDEX_ROW.Name: Upper left corner of tile, row coordinate, in full image coordinate grid
IMG_INDEX_ROW.Description: This field contains the upper left corner of tile, the row coordinate, in full image coordinate grid.

IMG_INDEX_COL.Name: Upper left corner of tile, column coordinate, in full image coordinate grid
IMG_INDEX_COL.Description: This field contains the upper left corner of tile, the col coordinate, in full image coordinate grid.

GEOID_OFFSET.Name: The Geoid offset
GEOID_OFFSET.Description: This field contains the distance from the reference ellipsoid to the MSL geoid at the reference point (ft).

ALPHA_0.Name: The cone angle
ALPHA_0.Description: This field contains the cone angle (radians).

K_L.Name: Left/right look flag
K_L.Description: This field contains the values indicating either left or right look.

C_M.Name: Speed of light adjusted
C_M.Description: This field contains the speed of light, adjusted for refractivity of atmosphere (m/s).

AC_ROLL.Name: Nominal Aircraft Roll
AC_ROLL.Description: This field contains the aircraft roll value (radians).

AC_PITCH.Name: Nominal Aircraft Pitch
AC_PITCH.Description: This field contains the aircraft pitch value (radians).

AC_YAW.Name: Nominal Aircraft Yaw
AC_YAW.Description: This field contains the aircraft yaw value (radians).

AC_TRACK_HEADING.Name: Nominal Aircraft Track Heading
AC_TRACK_HEADING.Description: This field contains the aircraft track heading value (radians).

AP_ORIGIN_X.Name: Synthetic aperture origin point x
AP_ORIGIN_X.Description: This field contains the X coordinate component of the synthetic aperature origin point in ECEF (m).

AP_ORIGIN_Y.Name: Synthetic aperture origin point y
AP_ORIGIN_Y.Description: This field contains the Y coordinate component of the synthetic aperature origin point in ECEF (m).

AP_ORIGIN_Z.Name: Synthetic aperture origin point z
AP_ORIGIN_Z.Description: This field contains the Z coordinate component of the synthetic aperature origin point in ECEF (m).

AP_DIR_X.Name: Synthetic aperture direction unit vector, X component, in ECEF
AP_DIR_X.Description: This field contains the X coordinate component of the synthetic aperature direction in ECEF (m).

AP_DIR_Y.Name: Synthetic aperture direction unit vector, Y component, in ECEF
AP_DIR_Y.Description: This field contains the Y coordinate component of the synthetic aperature direction in ECEF (m).

AP_DIR_Z.Name: Synthetic aperture direction unit vector, Z component, in ECEF
AP_DIR_Z.Description: This field contains the Z coordinate component of the synthetic aperature direction in ECEF (m).

X_AP_START.Name: Start point of synthetic aperture
X_AP_START.Description: This field contains the start point of synthetic aperture, relative to AP_ORIGIN along AP_DIR (m).

X_AP_END.Name: Start point of synthetic aperture
X_AP_END.Description: This field contains the start point of synthetic aperture, relative to AP_ORIGIN along AP_DIR (m).

SS_ROW_SHIFT.Name: Spot stitching row shift
SS_ROW_SHIFT.Description: This field contains the spot stitching row shift value. Positive values mean the subspot was shifted down in the stitching function.

SS_COL_SHIFT.Name: Spot stitching column shift
SS_COL_SHIFT.Description: This field contains the spot stitching column shift value. Positive values mean the subspot was shifted right in the stitching function.

U_HAT_X.Name: X component of u-hat
U_HAT_X.Description: This field contains the X component of u-hat.  NOTE: The u-hat, v-hat, and n-hat coordinates are great circle (nominal flight track) coordinates where: u-hat points in the semi-major axis direction, v-hat points in the semi-minor axis direction, and n-hat is the noraml vector to u-hat and v-hat.  The compnents of u-hat, v-hat, n-hat are in ECEF.

ETA_0.Name: Dummy parameter for leading edge of patch
ETA_0.Description: This field contains the dummy parameter for the leading edge of patch (n-naught) in radians).

SIGMA_SM.Name: Semi-major axis length
SIGMA_SM.Description: This field contains the length of the semi-major axis in (m).

SIGMA_SN.Name: Semi-minor axis length
SIGMA_SN.Description: This field contains the length of the semi-minor axis (m).

S_OFF.Name: Small circle origin off-set
S_OFF.Description: This field contains the small circle orgin off-set along the v-hat axis (m).

RN_OFFSET.Name: Off-set between small and great circle
RN_OFFSET.Description: This field contains the off-set between the small circle and great circle plane (m).

R_RCL.Name: Radius of scene center line

R_NAV.Description: This field contains the radius of curvature of nominal flight track (m).

C_SC_X.Name: X component of center of scene center line

P_Z.Name: Perpendicular distance form nav circle to scene circle
P_Z.Description: This field contains the perpendicular distance from navigation circle to scene center line circle (m).

THETA_C.Name: Angular offset from target to aperture center
THETA_C.Description: This field contains the angular offset from target to aperture center (radians).

ALPHA_SL.Name: Tangent cone apex parameter
ALPHA_SL.Description: This field contains the tangent cone apex parameter.

SIGMA_TC.Name: Tangent cone scale parameter
SIGMA_TC.Description: This field contains the tangent cone scale parameter.
